result.summary: The page layout is largely functional, but the promo banner has severely low text contrast (white on light green), the favourite (heart) buttons are styled inconsistently between cards, and several elements are clipped at the viewport edges, including a partially visible category chip and a truncated restaurant name.

issues.description: The green promotional banner uses white text ('3 free deliveries for you', 'Use code TALLINN3 at checkout · min. order €10') on a very light mint background, making it nearly illegible and failing WCAG contrast requirements.
issues.suggestion: Change the banner text to a dark green/near-black colour, or darken the banner background so text contrast is at least 4.5:1.

issues.description: The favourite heart buttons are inconsistent between the two 'Popular right now' cards: the first uses a white circular background with a dark outline heart, the second uses a dark/transparent circle with a white heart.
issues.suggestion: Standardise the favourite button style (same background, icon colour and size) across all restaurant cards.

issues.description: The second 'Popular right now' card (pizza) is cut off by the bottom navigation bar with no visible title, rating or metadata, making it look broken rather than a natural scroll cutoff.
issues.suggestion: Add bottom padding to the scroll content equal to the nav bar height so cards are never visually clipped by the fixed nav.

issues.description: In 'Fastest near you', the third card is clipped and its name is truncated mid-word ('Trattoria Piccol') with no ellipsis, and the delivery text is also cut at the screen edge.
issues.suggestion: Apply consistent horizontal padding/peek width for the carousel and use text ellipsis truncation on card titles.

issues.description: The category filter row shows a sliver of an unnamed chip at the right edge, which reads as a rendering glitch rather than a scrollable list.
issues.suggestion: Adjust the chip row peek amount so the next chip is either clearly partially visible with its label or fully hidden, and add a subtle fade/gradient to indicate scrollability.

issues.description: The notification bell's red dot indicator conveys new-notification state by colour/shape only with no text label.
issues.suggestion: Add an accessible label such as 'Notifications, 1 unread' to the bell button.
